verdict.rationale: Ghostty documents a first-party Quick Terminal, a quake-style dropdown that "animates down below the menu bar for instant access," and a community user calls it their "killer feature." The evidence never says how it is summoned, though: there is no documented system-wide hotkey binding, and the menu-bar wording suggests it is macOS-only. Missing for 10: documented global/system-wide hotkey to summon or toggle the terminal, confirmation of Quick Terminal on Linux, and configuration details such as position, animation and focus behavior.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can summon the terminal instantly with a global hotkey or quake-style dropdown window

citations.quote: Quick Terminal: Lightweight terminal that animates down below the menu bar for instant access without interrupting work.
The quick terminal feature is ghostty's killer feature for me.
